headlines.text: On this day in 2022, the AEW TNT Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Wardlow vs. Scorpio Sky battled it out in a Street Fight match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.25 ? ending the champion's reign at 4 defenses. This stood as the 50th match in AEW TNT Title history ? a real piece of championship history. Wardlow fought off interference from Dan Lambert's American Top Team, and three Powerbomb Symphonies later walked out with his first AEW championship.

Flash back to 2024, when Adam Page vs. Jay White met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Collision, rated 8.09 ? a genuinely great match. Christian Cage's surprise interference ? a spear on White ? let Page hit the Buckshot Lariat to advance in the Owen Hart Cup semifinals, foreshadowing an alliance to come.

Looking back to 2022, when Jon Moxley vs. Brody King clashed for the AEW Interim World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.03 ? a well-worked match. Brody King was challenging for gold for the very first time. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: it was the first-ever encounter between Rush and Penta Oscuro on Dynamite, rated 6.58.
2024 brought us this moment: Claudio Castagnoli vs. The Beast Mortos locked horns for the first time on Collision, rated 6.81.
On this day in 2024, Toni Storm vs. Trish Adora crossed paths for the first time ever on Collision, rated 5.36.
